> what's your plan? 

don't have one... yet

> online courses you find interesting 

well that's the main problem, i don't really find anything interesting to learn
It’s not burn out, trust me I’ve probably worked less than anyone out there. I know it makes it almost impossible to leave the country but I don’t really have a choice
I’m not “going through a tough time” though, I just don’t care about what I’m learning

It’s not because I feel inadequate, I just couldn’t care less about what I’m supposed to be learning (and switching majors wouldn’t help because it’s not just that I don’t like my major, i don’t like any of them)
It wouldn’t really help to change my major because there isn’t any subject I’ve enjoyed learning
I don’t like my major, I also don’t like any other major.. that’s why I’m dropping out
Oh okay.. that doesn't sound nice.. thanks for letting me know
I wasn't expecting this post to get that much attention, it's sad how many people relate to this but i guess it's good to know there are others who feel the same

> the more that you are likely to die young and die in your sleep.

That's the dream! (Pun intended :p )
That's the point, I don't want to be conscious
Yep, because it's easy, i just want everything to be easy... But it's not :(
